sloka: विभीषणस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।श्रूयतामस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमागतम् ।। ७.२५.२१ ॥
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu saṅkruddho bhrātaraṁ vākyamabravīt ।śrūyatāmasya pāpasya karmaṇaḥ phalamāgatam ।। 7.25.21 ॥

translations.english: But Vibhishana, greatly enraged, spoke to his brother, saying, "Listen, the consequence of this sinful deed has arrived."
